name: decode_stream

test_list.description: A leading UTF-8 BOM is removed.
UTF-16LE with BOM (PowerShell redirection) becomes UTF-8 text.
UTF-16BE with BOM becomes UTF-8 text.
CRLF and CR-only line ends are normalised to LF.
CSI colour codes and OSC titles (BEL or ST terminated) are removed.
An escape sequence never consumes a newline, so a hostile stream cannot hide later lines.
Control characters other than LF and TAB are dropped.
Invalid UTF-8 becomes U+FFFD instead of an error.
proptest: decoded text of arbitrary bytes contains no ESC and no CR.

inputs.name: bytes
inputs.description: Raw stream bytes in UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16.

output_description: Clean UTF-8 text with LF line ends and no terminal escapes.
